id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

model.description: A new {@link ReliabilityMlModel} that has been created in the target environment.

sourceModelId.description: The id of the {@link ReliabilityMlModel} in the source environment that corresponds to the migrated {@link #model}.

hasValidPredictions.description:
Indicates whether the migrated {@link ReliabilityMlModel} generates the same predictions as it's corresponding model
from the source environment, by comparing their predictions and contributions on a small sample dataset.

title:
This type stores the information in the target environment about the newly migrated {@link ReliabilityMlModel},
and it's corresponding model id in the source environment.
name: ReliabilityModelRegistry.TargetEntry
